title: My game company tycoon Gone Gold is heading into Early Access, and I'd like feedback from tycoon players
author: BraveRequirement7382
selftext:
Hi everyone,
    
    
    I'm the developer of Gone Gold: A Game Company Tycoon. I have been programming the game with Claude for months now, and I am on the verge of Early Access. You found a small game studio, plan and release games, and lead the company through the decades, starting as early as 1980. The name on Steam is still incorrect, don't be surprised that it’s still labeled "Gold master". 
    
    
    The focus is on detailed planning and a market that reacts to you:
    
    Plan every game
    
    - 49 genres with around 280 subgenres, and 833 themes with combinations that work and clashes that don't
    - More than 800 features, game modes, story or career mode, graphics style, sound, platforms and languages
    - A recommend button fills in sensible values when you don't want to tweak everything
    
    A living market
    
    - 60 to 90 rival studios announce games, delay them, merge, go public or go bankrupt
    - Weekly and yearly charts, industry awards with nominations, press and player reviews
    - Every four weeks the in-game magazine GameWire reports on your studio and the competition
    
    Licenses
    
    - Secure a racing series or a football league and make the official game, with a new edition every season
    - Release before the season starts or the fans move on. Movie, band and celebrity licenses work too
    
    Run the company
    
    - Hire and train your team, build the office room by room, develop your own engine
    - Publishers, loans, the stock market, subsidiaries, your own console and data centers for online games
    
    
    There is also a sandbox mode, adjustable game rules and 30 languages.
    
    
    Early Access
    
    
    The game is playable from start to finish. I'm going into Early Access because a simulation this big needs many players to get the economy right. A multiplayer mode where friends run competing studios in the same world is planned for 1.0.
    
    
    Full disclosure: I built the game with a lot of help from Claude, including the code and the translations. The Steam page says so as well.
    
    
    Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5322340/Gold_Master_A_Game_Company_Tycoon/?beta=0

comments.author: lordwest7121
comments.body: Looks fun. Curious what kind of gameplay or features your game has that differs from Mad Games Tycoon 2? I am totally fine with a solely UI driven game, as I am a big fan of Gear City, but have you had any thoughts on how you could add more visual elements?
